news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹1.11 loss per share (vs ₹1.63 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹1.11 loss per share (improved from ₹1.63 loss in 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹189.2m (loss narrowed 10% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 59% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 46% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: New major risk - Shareholder dilution
news.body: The company's shareholders have been substantially diluted in the past year. Increase in shares outstanding: 30% This is considered a major risk. Shareholder dilution occurs when there is an increase in the number of shares on issue that is not proportionally distributed between all shareholders. Often due to the company raising equity capital or some options being converted into stock. All else being equal, if there are more shares outstanding then each existing share will be entitled to a lower proportion of the company's total earnings, thus reducing earnings per share (EPS). While dilution might not always result in lower EPS (like if the company is using the capital to fund an EPS accretive acquisition) in a lot cases it does, along with lower dividends per share and less voting power

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.2% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Deccan Gold Mines Limited (BSE:512068) proposed to acquire an unknown minority stake in Tungsten Project in Spain.
news.body: Deccan Gold Mines Limited (BSE:512068) proposed to acquire an unknown minority stake in Tungsten Project in Spain on December 23, 2025. Deccan Gold Mines Limited can acquire up to a 75% stake in the Tungsten Project in Spain prior production.
